title: Serengeti Family Safari, in Comfort
summary: A permanent-camp safari built around families — shorter drives, family tents, a kids' tracking program, and a pool to cool off between game drives.
highlights: A junior ranger tracking program for kids
A swimming pool back at camp

itinerary.title: Arrive & settle in
itinerary.description: A private transfer to a permanent camp with a pool and family tents.

itinerary.title: Family game drives
itinerary.description: Shorter morning drives paced for kids, with afternoons free at camp.

itinerary.title: Junior ranger day
itinerary.description: Kids join a tracking and conservation program while adults game-drive.

itinerary.title: Full-day safari
itinerary.description: A longer drive out toward the migration, packed lunch included.

itinerary.title: Village visit
itinerary.description: A local school visit, arranged directly, not a staged stop.

itinerary.title: Depart camp
itinerary.description: A final morning drive before transferring out.

included: 6 nights in a family-friendly permanent camp
All meals and a private vehicle & guide
A dedicated trip consultant, reachable throughout
excluded: Gratuities for camp staff and guides
